AI Usage Sentinel 1.8.0 adds Agent Usage Limit monitoring with a sourced Reset Watch & Forecast.

- Priority watch for Tibo (@thsottiaux): reset polls, hints, related voting replies, and explicit completion announcements.
- User-selected 75% source weight for @codex_resets; editorial 85% priority weight for the Tibo radar. Weights decay with age and are not probabilities of a future reset.
- Free, documented Codex Resets API and best-effort public Codex Reset radar. Original X URLs and data-provider attribution retained. Secondary feed coverage is incomplete; original polls provide live options/counts.
- Polls and forecasts remain separate from actual account resets. A newer completion retires older hints. Same-post updates can upgrade to an announcement; duplicate mirrors never stack weights or become official confirmation.
- Native Reset Watch includes a dated month calendar with month navigation, source/event credibility bars, source links, personal account correlation and fresh watch status. Website adds five languages, filters and an independent source-health display.
- No paid X API, browser credentials, invented next-reset date, or account-history upload. Source monitoring is optional in Settings → Sources.

macOS 14+, universal Apple Silicon/Intel. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Windows/Linux are unsigned beta ports; CI validation does not replace physical desktop validation. Existing data locations and updater trust remain unchanged. Replace the previous app rather than running both copies.
